extension.summary: Backup and restore LibreELEC system settings and configurations
extension.description: Automatically backup and restore your LibreELEC system settings, configurations, and addons. Supports local and remote storage locations with smart backup rotation.
extension.disclaimer: This addon is not affiliated with LibreELEC or Kodi.
extension.news:
v1.5.0 (2026-04-12) - FEATURE RELEASE - Compared to v1.4.1.7 - Added fully custom dashboard and backup browser windows with skin XML layouts (1080i/720p) - Added custom settings/help details with clearer guidance per setting - Added optional backup summary popup toggle in Notifications settings - Added remote storage usage status details to dashboard when available - Improved restore UX with reliable progress updates and reduced notification noise - Added detailed, colorized operation summaries with scroll-friendly formatting - Improved backup detection and date parsing for legacy and current backup naming formats - Hardened restore handling for non-critical file errors (permissions/long names/.git metadata) - Improved Remote Settings Test Connection output with cleaner structured protocol diagnostics - Changed message/confirm/text popups to consistently use custom GUI dialogs with fallback - Fixed Credits entries to remain informational and non-editable - Fixed duplicate setting popup activation and tab navigation edge cases
v1.4.1.7 (2026-01-12) - TEST RELEASE - Added switchable verbose logging that elevates debug details into the Kodi log - Expanded diagnostic logging for backup creation, uploads, and remote connections - Default verbose logging enabled for this test build to aid investigation
v1.4.1.6 (2026-01-09) - TEST RELEASE - Fixed RemoteBrowser password initialization that broke Test Connection dialogs - Restored remote password loading in BackupManager for all remote protocols - Added structured verbose debug logging across backup, restore, and remote connection flows - Rebuilt zip with correct addon folder structure for installation
v1.4.1.5 (2026-01-05) - TEST RELEASE - Fixed NFS remote browsing with improved user feedback and validation - Fixed SMB backup creation by correcting path format handling - Fixed View Backups and Restore Backup operations to show backup lists instead of remote browser dialogues - Enhanced get_all_backups method to support all remote protocols (NFS, SMB, FTP, SFTP, WebDAV) - Improved local backup path validation to prevent issues with NFS mount paths - Fixed backup listing to show proper dates, sizes, and selection interface
v1.4.1.4 (2026-01-04) - FIX RELEASE - Fixed NFS mounting with nolock option for better compatibility - Fixed SMB browsing path conversion (smb://server/share -> server:/share) - Fixed local backup path handling for NFS mounts - Improved error handling for remote connections
v1.4.1.3 (2026-01-04) - FIX RELEASE - Fixed addon zip structure for proper Kodi installation
v1.4.1.3 (2025-12-30) - TEST RELEASE - Fixed NFS connection and path format handling - Improved SMB browsing with better path validation - Enhanced SFTP error messages and paramiko handling - Settings now auto-save immediately when changed
v1.4.1.2 (2025-12-30) - Fixed restore from backup failing due to read-only file system error - Added automatic mounting/unmounting of addons directory during restore
